nordvpn on Omarchy

Encrypt and route your traffic through NordVPN's global network, right from the terminal.

Package data synced 2026-10-19 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install nordvpn on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add nordvpn-bin. It is a 42.3 MB download (122.7 MB installed), version 5.4.1-1, licensed GPL3. NordVPN CLI tool for Linux. App is free to install; VPN server access needs a paid NordVPN plan (from about $3.49/mo on longer terms).

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install nordvpn on Omarchy

This is NordVPN's official command-line client for Linux, letting you connect to NordVPN's VPN servers, enable a kill switch, set up split tunneling, and manage settings without a graphical app. The CLI itself is free to install, but connecting to actual VPN servers requires logging into a paid NordVPN account, the app's free Meshnet feature is the exception.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add nordvpn-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 5.4.1-1:
    pacman -Qi nordvpn-bin

Open and use nordvpn

nordvpn has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql nordvpn-bin | grep /usr/bin/

nordvpn requirements and compatibility

  • A NordVPN account
  • An active paid NordVPN subscription to use the VPN servers
  • Network access

Pricing and license

App is free to install; VPN server access needs a paid NordVPN plan (from about $3.49/mo on longer terms). License: GPL3.

Uninstall nordvpn

omarchy pkg drop nordvpn-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install nordvpn on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add nordvpn-bin. The download is 42.3 MB and it takes 122.7 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is nordvpn free?

App is free to install; VPN server access needs a paid NordVPN plan (from about $3.49/mo on longer terms). The package is licensed GPL3.

How do I uninstall nordvpn?

Run omarchy pkg drop nordvpn-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does nordvpn depend on?

nordvpn declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is nordvpn a desktop app?

No. nordvpn has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is nordvpn in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as nordvpn-bin (version 5.4.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Nord Security makes it. Project site: https://nordvpn.com/download/linux/.
